title: Compactly supported finite-mass cycles with the integer slice property are integer multiplicity, given SLIM and LD (White's tangent-plane argument, parent V6–V15)
statement: Assume (MR), (IMC), (VO) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, dtc_vanish_off_support). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P, n := d + 1, and let ISP be the integer slice property of sibling slice_limit. Assume SLIM_{P,d} (weak limits X of ISP currents X_i ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with sup_i(M_W(X_i) + M_W(∂X_i)) < ∞ for bounded open W have ISP) and LD_{P,d} (there is η₀ > 0 such that for every ISP cycle C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and every representation (μ, ξ) of C with μ finite on compacts, μ(W) = M_W(C) for open W and |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e., liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀ for μ-a.e. x). Then CYC_{P,d}: every Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂Γ = 0, M(Γ) < ∞, compact support and ISP(Γ) is IM.
